title: Econ Field Kit: Operationalizing batching, KV-cache and quantization across fleets
creator: Priya Patel
description: Create an 'Econ Field Kit' — a compact set of artifacts, turn-key configs, and runbooks that product and platform teams can use to safely reduce token/unit costs by applying batching, KV-cache prefetching, and post-training quantization profiles. The kit targets 3 flows: synchronous low-latency chat, high-throughput async generation, and embeddings pipelines. Core deliverables: (1) Pilot configs and canary policy template, (2) Operator runbooks for tuning batch sizes and cache TTL, (3) Observable dashboards and guardrail alerts for quality/regression detection, (4) A/B test harness and rollout gating metrics, (5) Pre-built quant profiles tuned for common open models. Success metrics/OKRs: 10-20% unit-cost reduction across pilot customers without >5% quality regression, maintain p50 latency within existing SLOs, and <1% increased error rate.
acceptance_criteria: Field kit artifacts published to internal registry and public template repo
Pilot executed on two customers (one chat, one embeddings) with before/after econ dashboard
Canary rollout gates implemented in Console with automatic rollback on quality regressions
Two quant profiles validated on runtime-1.22 with detailed perf/cost matrix in dashboards
updates: 2026-02-05: Kickoff meeting with Eng (Alex C), Runtime (Diego M), Observability (Lina S). Agreed scope and three pilot customers. Action: eng to prototype dynamic batch sizing experiment.

2026-02-18: Runtime prototype shows 12% batch-level unit savings at 512 token median with auto-batching; p95 latency increased by 40ms. Decision: limit auto-batch growth for chat flows to preserve p50 SLA.
2026-02-25: Design review — Console needs a canary policy editor for econ gates. PM requested simple presets: conservative, balanced, aggressive.
2026-03-01: QA flagged non-deterministic tokenization difference after quantized model A; research to reproduce. Action: ENG-12033 assigned for quant validation harness.
2026-03-06: Data from staging pilot_1 (embeddings) shows 18% cost reduction, negligible downstream accuracy delta. Preparing customer-facing case study draft (link below).
2026-03-10: Security review request submitted for pilot customer data handling and KMS usage (ticket SEC-449).
2026-03-12: Updated rollout timeline to include a 2-week shadow phase before canary; added monitoring for semantic drift via eval prompts.
notes: Trade-offs considered: aggressive batching yields best unit savings but amplifies tail latency and KV cache churn. Quantization reduces memory and throughput cost but introduces subtle tokenization/rounding deltas for long-context prompts. Plan is to provide conservative presets plus an advanced tuning section for platform teams.
